annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the others are frozen, each hoping someone else will speak first
annotations.ce_supportive_use: so I'd be the one who speaks
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: one life lost set against the very real chance of losing more

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My hunch is the group wants something that feels fair
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: a draw gives everyone an even shot they can live with
annotations.ce_supportive_use: a draw gives everyone an even shot they can live with

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I sense a couple of people are close to panic
annotations.ce_supportive_use: a clear plan right now would steady them
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: just not more than getting five people off that island

annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd tell them straight that nobody will judge them either way
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Whoever stays should stay by choice, not guilt.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: One loss instead of risking six is simple enough.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: expect the others to carry some guilt about leaving me
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Lifting that weight off them is the last useful thing I could do

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I don't think I'm obliged to hand over my life
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they'd want that choice treated as real
annotations.ce_supportive_use: help the rest of us honour it by moving

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the others are scared of being the one chosen
annotations.ce_supportive_use: my volunteering takes that fear off all five at once
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: My life for five certain rescues is a price I'd pay.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: nobody wants to be the person who asks someone else to stay
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Naming it plainly clears the air so we can act.
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: A burden shared fairly, decided quickly, beats one person being pushed.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: privately feels they ought to offer and is dreading it
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: My life against five people out and gone fast
